title: GAMMA.INV: 18 of 60 on the corpus the inverter was validated on
status_plain: Replacing early-stop bisection with float-lattice bisection to adjacent doubles moved GAMMA.INV from 8 to 18 of 60 and collapsed a +880,380 ULP catastrophe to -16 ULP. b14 is explicitly the corpus the inverter was validated on, with the held-out b19 captured separately, so this is a repair-target figure. The publication rule was raced on the same corpus -- publish-hi 18/60 against publish-closest 17/60 and publish-lo 7/60 -- and hi was retained. No post-BRATIO or post-chain-exp re-score of GAMMA.INV exists, even though the forward it roots was replaced twice afterwards.
